secretF.q1: What do their eyes do when you're in the same room?
secretF.q1a: Nothing special, she looks at me the way she looks at everyone.
secretF.q1b: Our eyes meet now and then, like anyone's would.
secretF.q1c: I often catch her looking at me, and she looks away.
secretF.q1d: She looks for my reaction whenever she says something funny.
secretF.q2: Does she remember things you only said once?
secretF.q2a: No, I usually have to repeat myself.
secretF.q2b: The broad strokes, like any friend would.
secretF.q2c: Yes, precise details that surprise me when she brings them back up.
secretF.q2d: She remembers even things I said in passing, without thinking.
secretF.q3: How do the two of you end up alone together, usually?
secretF.q3b: When chance works out that way, nothing more.
secretF.q3c: She often suggests one-to-one occasions: a coffee, a lift, a favour.
secretF.q3d: She invents excuses, and it shows a little.
secretF.q4: Is she the same with you in a group as one to one?
secretF.q4b: A bit more relaxed one to one, but nothing striking.
secretF.q4c: One to one she opens up far more, and in a group she goes neutral again.
secretF.q4d: In a group she almost deliberately keeps her distance from me.
secretF.q5: What happens with the physical distance between you?
secretF.q5a: Nothing, we keep the same distance as with everyone else.
secretF.q5b: We greet each other, nothing more.
secretF.q5c: She often ends up next to me, and stays closer than necessary.
secretF.q5d: She finds small excuses for contact, a hand on the arm, a shoulder.
secretF.q6: What do their replies to your messages look like?
secretF.q6a: Short, and sometimes she forgets to answer.
secretF.q6b: Normal, no faster and no longer than with anyone else.
secretF.q6c: Often very fast, and often longer than my own message.
secretF.q6d: She restarts the conversation when it stops, even over nothing.
secretF.q7: What does she do when you talk about someone you like?
secretF.q7a: She asks questions, it seems to amuse her.
secretF.q7b: They listen, with no particular reaction.
secretF.q7c: She changes the subject, or goes very quiet all of a sudden.
secretF.q7d: She criticises the person, or finds a flaw every time.
secretF.q8: How do the people around them behave when you show up?
secretF.q8a: Normally, I don't really know their friends.
secretF.q8c: There are sideways smiles, or a silence when I arrive.
secretF.q8d: Someone has already teased me about it, or hinted at something.
secretF.q9: What does she actually talk to you about?
secretF.q9b: Their day, their plans, nothing very personal.
secretF.q9c: She tells me things she doesn't tell other people.
secretF.q9d: She compliments me on who I am rather than on how I look.
secretF.q10: And you, what brought you here?
secretF.q10b: A remark from a friend that put the idea in my head.
secretF.q10c: A feeling that keeps coming back over the last few weeks.
secretF.q10d: I'm almost sure of it, but she has never said a word.
